controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable imagery over the published 2002 CE26 primary radar reconstruction. No secondary is included. The north polar region was hidden or observed above 60° radar incidence. The selected pole is approximate, and display phase is arbitrary.
controls.title: Radar shape model

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows the original model radius minus a 1.73 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential or independent topography. Colors are transferred from the full source surface to the displayed triangles. Only the primary is included; the north polar region is poorly constrained. Optional Sun lighting uses an approximate pole and arbitrary phase. Cartographic relief is a prepared display treatment.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
